body:
## Pull request overview

Implements the remaining Q2 §2.7 Console UX items for the console app by adding favorites persistence/UI, a first-time onboarding walkthrough, and a dedicated full-page search route, plus marking the corresponding ROADMAP items complete.

**Changes:**
- Added `useFavorites` hook with localStorage persistence + tests, and rendered a Favorites section in the sidebar.
- Added `OnboardingWalkthrough` dialog (first-visit) + tests, and mounted it in `AppContent`.
- Added `SearchResultsPage` at `/apps/:appName/search?q=...` and a Command Palette action to open it; updated ROADMAP checkboxes.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/hooks/useFavorites.ts | New hook for persisted favorites with add/remove/toggle helpers. |
| apps/console/src/components/SearchResultsPage.tsx | New full-page search UI that indexes app navigation items and groups results. |
| apps/console/src/components/OnboardingWalkthrough.tsx | New first-time onboarding dialog persisted via localStorage. |
| apps/console/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx | Adds an “Open Full Search Page” command item. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds Favorites section UI and unfavorite action in the sidebar. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/Onboarding.test.tsx | New tests for onboarding behavior and persistence. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/Favorites.test.tsx | New tests for `useFavorites` behavior and persistence. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Registers `/search` route and mounts onboarding. |
| ROADMAP.md | Checks off Console UX Enhancement (§2.7) items as completed. |
</details>

Favorites are rendered and can be removed, but there’s no UI entry point in the console that calls `addFavorite`/`toggleFavorite` (and `useFavorites` is only used here + tests). As-is, users can’t actually favorite items through the app, which conflicts with the onboarding copy (“Star frequently used items”). Consider adding a toggle action where navigation items are rendered (or in CommandPalette/Object views).

These tests rely on real timeouts (`setTimeout`/sleep) to wait for the 800ms onboarding delay, which slows the suite and can be flaky under load. Prefer `vi.useFakeTimers()` + `vi.advanceTimersByTime()` (wrapped in `act`) to make the tests deterministic and fast.

`query` state is initialized from `q` once but never updates when the URL search params change (e.g., browser back/forward or external navigation to a different `?q=`). This can desync the input/results from the actual URL; consider syncing `query` from `searchParams` in an effect keyed on `queryParam` (or derive `query` directly from `searchParams`).

Search results are built from `activeApp.navigation` without applying `evaluateVisibility` like AppSidebar/CommandPalette do. This can surface navigation entries that are meant to be hidden for the current user/context; consider importing `useExpressionContext` + `evaluateVisibility` and filtering nav items before indexing them.

This mapping ignores navigation items of type `url` (leaving `href` as `#` and filtering them out). In this repo, `objectstack.shared.ts` patches CRM reports into navigation as `type: 'url'`, so reports will never appear in full-page search. Consider supporting `url` items (using `item.url` as `href`, and optionally categorizing by the destination path).

`flattenNavigation` duplicates the same helper already present in `CommandPalette.tsx`. Keeping two copies risks behavior drift (e.g., visibility filtering, supported item types). Consider extracting this into a shared util (or reusing one implementation).

SearchResultsPage introduces a new user-facing route/feature, but there are no tests covering its main behaviors (query param sync, grouping, visibility filtering, navigation item type handling). Given other console pages have dedicated tests, adding a minimal test suite would help prevent regressions.
